page: Microsoft Azure D4ps_v7 is an ARM-based general-purpose virtual machine running on Microsoft Hyper-V. Powered by an arm64 processor, this instance provisions 4 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 16.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. It operates without dedicated hardware accelerators or GPUs.

Storage architecture for the D4ps_v7 relies entirely on remote storage, as no local disk storage is included. The instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with Azure remote block storage volumes for persistent operational needs. Network connectivity does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring standard Azure virtual network routing or external IP assignment configurations.

With its energy-efficient 64-bit ARM architecture, the D4ps_v7 delivers balanced compute density and favorable cost efficiency compared to traditional x86-based general-purpose instances. Workloads targeting this instance should be compiled or compatible with arm64 Linux distributions. It is appropriate for mid-sized general-purpose workloads, including web application servers, microservices architectures, containerized environments, and development or continuous integration pipelines.
